programs.title: Peter Rabbit
programs.desc: Welcome to the magical world of Peter Rabbit, whose taste for radishes & thirst for adventure propels him & his friends through enchanting escapades & action-packed adventures that will delight & thrill you. Peter's friends & foes are all there-Benjamin, Lily, Mr. McGregor, Squirrel Nutkin, Flopsy & Mopsy, & more. So get hopping!

programs.title: Mister Maker Around The World
programs.desc: In Australia, we find out whether he can make a wacky watch in under a minute; in the UK the Mini Makers help build a fabulous fairytale castle; and in Hong Kong look out for some really snappy art!

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.desc: Captain Feathersword's hat and sword keep falling to the ground, they need your help, shout out when the hat or sword falls! The Wiggles try different dance moves to help Captain, will one of them work?

programs.title: Play School
programs.desc: Join Abi, Alex and Sofya as they draw facial expressions, send messages using emojis and sing a rainbow signing all the colours in Auslan. Through The Windows we see some playful puppeteering.

programs.title: Wilfrid Gordon Mcdonald Partridge
programs.desc: When 6-year-old Wilfrid discovers his 96-year-old best friend Nancy has lost her memory, he embarks on a heartwarming quest to help her remember. Based on the classic children's book by Mem Fox.

programs.title: We're Going On A Bear Hunt
programs.desc: A moving and reflective adaptation of Michael Rosen's book that follows the intrepid adventures of siblings Stan, Katie, Rosie, baby Max, and Rufus the dog, who come up against a host of obstacles on their quest in search of bears.
